question: Is each strategy's immediately prior-period stressed return per occupied risk-slot hour stable and incrementally more informative than return per lifecycle, strongly enough to justify one later whole-portfolio slot-value priority Proxy?

immutable_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_declaration_feasibility.inspection_scope: Birth and close event type, strategy identity and server timestamps only; close P/L, stressed R, slot value, rankings and information gates were not calculated.
pre_declaration_feasibility.failed_invocation_disclosure: The first event-type count used a nonexistent event_type column and emitted no duration or economic metric. The existing event header names the field event; only that column reference was corrected for feasibility.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each fresh period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and source path plus source line. CLOSE and EXTERNAL_CLOSE precede a birth at equal time.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_birth: PASSIVE_PLACE stores positive planned risk; only its matched PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive occupancy.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle and value_b is native stressed net USD.
fixed_reconstruction.occupied_hours: Exact elapsed server wall-clock seconds from admitted birth to close divided by 3600. Weekend and closed-market elapsed time remains included because the risk slot stayed occupied.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: native stressed net USD divided by positive birth planned risk
fixed_reconstruction.period_slot_value: For one strategy-period, sum raw stressed_r across its lifecycles divided by sum occupied_hours. No per-lifecycle division, clamp, trim or transform is used.
fixed_reconstruction.period_mean_r: Arithmetic mean raw stressed_r for the same strategy-period; this is the fixed comparator that omits occupancy time.
fixed_reconstruction.causal_transition: P1 scores predict P2, P2 scores predict P3 and P3 scores predict P4. A period never predicts itself, cumulative and future periods are excluded, and fresh-period Tester resets remain separate.
fixed_reconstruction.ranking: Rank six strategies descending by the prior period metric with average ranks for exact ties and lexicographic strategy name only for deterministic top-list display.
fixed_reconstruction.rank_metric: Average-rank Spearman correlation across all six strategies between the prior-period predictor ranking and current-period realized slot-value ranking.
fixed_reconstruction.top_two_capture: For each transition, take the two highest prior-period slot-value strategies and test whether each lands in the current period's top three slot values and whether its current slot value is positive.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain the listed bytes and SHA-256 values and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 closed lifecycles with strategy totals RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594.
Reconstruct exact period stressed nets 148.8735, 54.6630, 113.0380 and 90.4732 USD and pooled 407.0477 USD.
Every lifecycle has one positive planned risk, one finite strictly positive occupied_hours value and exactly one close; no same-strategy overlap or Passive pending fault is allowed.
Every strategy has at least 20 lifecycles in every period before any ranking gate is evaluated.

slot_value_rank_stability: At least two of the three prior-to-current slot-value Spearman correlations are at least 0.60.
All three slot-value Spearman correlations are strictly positive.
top_value_capture: At least four of the six prior-period top-two selections land in the next period's actual top three slot values.
At least four of those six selections have positive next-period realized slot value.
incremental_occupancy_information: For each transition compare slot-value Spearman with the Spearman from prior-period mean_r to current-period slot value.
Slot value exceeds the mean-r comparator by at least 0.10 in at least two of three transitions.
The median of the three slot-minus-mean-r Spearman differences is at least 0.10.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later independently identified whole-six-strategy shared-portfolio priority Proxy using only the immediately prior completed period's strategy slot value. It may alter only capacity assignment among genuine conflicts, must retain the unchanged 4%/12% risk gates, cannot preempt an incumbent or suppress an unopposed eligible entry, must admit at least as many total entries as frozen first-come, and cannot authorize Live.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no slot-value priority question. Do not rescue with median or per-lifecycle R/hour, clipping, trimming, market-open hours, fixed maximum hold, cumulative history, exponential decay, strategy subset, period omission, alternate rank threshold or blend with another score.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before calculating any stressed R, period slot value, ranking or information gate.
Run exactly one successful fixed in-memory aggregation; an implementation-only failure before any metric or verdict may be corrected once and disclosed.
Do not retain a reusable analysis CLI, run MT5, add MQL, or modify any source family.
Do not use Unit 036 unread rows or reopen Unit 035, the old reservation policies or their failed gates.
Do not query, restart or alter Live.
